title: Support representation of matrix action
statement: Let $H$ be an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$ and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The sum of the columns of $H$ indexed by the support of $\gamma$ equals $H\gamma$.
